content: We need to determine SMILES of unknown sample with minimal analysis. We have many tools: we can get mass spec, NMR, IR, etc. Probably need to use mass spec to get molecular weight, then maybe NMR to deduce structure. But we don't know sample. We need to infer from data? The prompt doesn't give any data. We need to request data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra (no args). Let's call correctly.
